findings.title: Feature-disabled case does not assert the new exit code 4
findings.body: testFeatureNotEnabled only asserts the error message 'Unable to use this command. The preview feature rolling-updates is not enabled.' but does not verify the process exit code is CompatibilityResult.FEATURE_DISABLED (4). The exit code is the documented, scriptable contract for this tool (the guide documents exit code 4 specifically for the disabled-feature case), so a regression that prints the message but returns the wrong exit code would go unnoticed. Add assertEquals(4, cliResult.exitCode()) or equivalent.

findings.title: Default-strategy (null) test runs without the rolling-updates feature enabled
findings.body: In createInitialDeployment the ROLLING_UPDATES feature is only enabled when updateStrategy is non-null. The docs (advanced-configuration.adoc) state that while the rolling-updates feature is in preview it must be enabled or the operator will fail whenever the update spec is used. The null-strategy parameterization therefore exercises the CR update path without the feature, which per the documented contract is unsupported. If the operator is later changed to reject update-spec usage without the feature, this test will break; conversely, if the feature is not actually required for the default strategy, the documentation caution is misleading. Clarify the contract and align test and docs.
